# Plugins

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate_bundles_doc.py from registry/ — do not edit by hand. -->

Each **subject** (a tool, library, language, or workflow) is one plugin.
Claude Code publishes every bundle; Codex currently publishes the portable
skill-only pilot shown below.

## Install

### Claude Code

Add the marketplace, then install the subject plugin(s) you need:

```bash
/plugin marketplace add nq-rdl/agent-extensions
/plugin install <subject>@rdl-agent-extensions
```

New to the team? Install `rdl-team` first for onboarding, setup, and config-management workflows:

```bash
/plugin install rdl-team@rdl-agent-extensions
```

### Codex

Add this repository as a marketplace, then install one of the Codex-enabled subjects:

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add nq-rdl/agent-extensions
codex plugin add <subject>@rdl-agent-extensions
```

See [Codex support](codex.md) for the pilot bundle list, verification commands, and limitations.
